title: Conditional κ = 7.49917931696438e-4: 1,720 kernel entries, second descent, 440 restorations and 7 sinks on #296's gen5b word (every gen5-lineage stage re-derived)
body:
Conditional κ = `374958965848219/(5·10^17)` = **7.49917931696438e-4**, +0.430 % over [#296](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/296)'s gen5b word (7.46709720962478e-4), +0.591 % over [#295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/295) (7.45513573133379e-4), +0.697 % over [#291](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/291), +0.780 % over [#287](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/287). The bit side binds below #233's complex supplier.

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5b-full/`, with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**Full replay:** running now on the committed package (`fd51617`); the pin-recording replay of every stage already produced this κ. This PR will be marked ready when `verify.py` finishes.

## What it is

Every bit-side stage of the gen5 lineage composed on chafreaky's **gen5b** word (#296), each re-derived on gen5b with its own discovery script and frozen selection, in #295's pipeline (parity → descent → target → kernel → **second descent** → restore → sink → lowering, scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite):

| stage (credited) | on gen5 (#287/#290/#291/#295) | on gen5b (this package) |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| concave-descent retiming (#287; #296's re-derivation) | 904 gates | 904 gates (#296's selection) |
| target-prefix squares (eumemic #268; #287; #296's re-derivation) | 220 | 220 (#296's selection) |
| collective response-kernel entries (chafreaky #290; Dugongue #254/#283) | 450 entries, rank 1,022 | **1,720 entries** (920 twin pairs, 425 triples, 375 quadruples), entrance rank **2,192** |
| second concave descent with constructed frames (#291) | 89 gates | 89 gates (34 new bases) |
| early restoration of cleanup helpers (#280; #295) | 440 helpers | 440 helpers |
| terminal sinks (#283; #295) | 8 | 7 (R 15,434 → 15,427) |

**Kernel entries on gen5b.** #295's discovery (`discovery/coll/load.py` → `families.py` → `pack.py` → `build_selection.py`) on the gen5b word after the descent and squares: 13,200 plain dirty helpers, 1,632 triangles and 10,041 quadruples at class level, 6,863 families with a common cut and a nondegenerate common entrance; the greedy packing under the deficit-fixed φ ledger keeps 1,720 — gen5b's alternative local design makes far more helper responses coincide than gen5's (450). The φ ledger predicted κ = 7.49121e-4 for this stage alone and the replay reproduced it exactly; the second descent, restorations and sinks add the rest.

**Bank tiling.** With 1,574 residual-23 pivots, #283's (r⁴, 4³⁰⁻ʳ) pivot banks would need ~188k rank-4 blocks against the ~104k the width-4 helpers supply, so `bank_template.build_patterns` gives each pivot residual r the banks (r⁴, 24ᵃ, 4ᵇ) with 120 − 4r = 24a + 4b (a = ⌊(120−4r)/24⌋), taking plain 24-blocks from the (24⁵) banks. Every bank still partitions its 120 coordinates; all 4,628,100 role/replica/stage assignments are enumerated, the per-pattern endpoint controls run as before (807,350 banks; 910 exact charts incl. 440 (σ, E) charts; selector calls 905,994,209,400 < 2⁴⁰).

**Everything else** is #295's and #296's code unchanged: #296's word, generator and word constants (R = 15,434; 18,954 formal columns; 753,472 parity ADDs; entrances 20 × 2,182, 21 × 34, 18 × 16, 17 × 2); #295's transforms, endpoint-aware completions `P_σ + I − P_E`, pins plumbing and #233 complex stage; #291's `descent_transform.py` run a second time with `descent2-selection.json` and `raw_ledger.rebind_descent2`. Every changed count is a recomputed pinned value in `expected/kernel-pins.json`; none dropped.

| one invocation, m = 120 | #296 (gen5b) | this package |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| helper registers R | 15,434 | **15,427** |
| independent entrances | 2,234 | **3,954** |
| literal stock, 60 replicas | 1,236,750 | **1,229,750** |
| priced calls / rank mass | — | 482,960 / 2,691,640 |
| κ | 7.46709720962478e-4 | **7.49917931696438e-4** |

## Verify

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5b-full/requirements.txt
```
```bash
python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5b-full/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5b-full-verification
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, a new output directory outside the package; no network; about 7 minutes. Prints `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_RESTORE_SINK_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION` with the pinned κ. `gen5bit/producer/regenerate.py --work /tmp/gen5b-regeneration` rebuilds #296's pinned bit files byte for byte.

## Scope and credits

Exactly #295's/#296's hypotheses and conditional interfaces (all-size compiler, weighted chart, restored rows, selectors, routing, prime supply, precision/recovery, complex symbolic correctness, analytic reduction). No new Lean build. #285, #287, #290, #291, #295 and #296 are open; their word, generator and stages are inherited unchanged and not re-proved.

chafreaky (#296: the gen5b word and its re-pinned package; #295: the restoration/sink stages, the pins plumbing and the #233 complex stage; #290/#282/#284: the collective kernel stage and discovery); DreamingOfClouds (#285, #276): the generator and gen4/gen5 word design; utcorvusvolat-dotcom (#280): early restorations; Dugongue (#283, #254/#259/#272): terminal sinks, response kernels, endpoint-aware banking and the pivot tiling rule; eumemic (#268, #244, #234 lineage): the target-prefix mechanism, the common-frame retiming and the package machinery; hcg890 and Jacob Sussman (#234): the five-stage layout; Evan McKinney (#197): completed banks; #233/#256 and jacobalansussman/wht-power-saving-lean#2: the complex supplier. This package contributes the composition, the three re-derived selections, the second descent on gen5b and the generalized pivot banks. Prepared by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance; Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`.
